metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Rust (std-only) RS274/NGC G-code simulator as a Cargo project under `output/`.

- Build: `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- Run: `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <gcode_file> --output <result_file> [options]`
- Implemented options: `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--trace-output` with exactly one of `--trace-time-step` / `--trace-distance-step` / `--trace-position-tolerance`.
- Writes `--output` JSON on both success and error; writes `--trace-output` JSON on both success and error when configured; writes `--parameter-output` only on success.

Files:
- `output/Cargo.toml`
- `output/src/main.rs`
